caption:
You're exhausted from proving yourself. What if your life could be the proof, so the arguing could finally stop? (Galatians 2:1-2 devotional)

You're worn out from proving yourself, so you argue louder and longer — but words against words only harden the whole room. Paul brought no argument, just Titus: an uncircumcised Greek made whole by the gospel, and that living evidence silenced everyone. You are not the argument for your own worth; Christ finished it in you, and a finished life needs no defense.
